verdict.rationale: Shopify documents dev stores as testing environments you own, explicitly 'without affecting any live store'. Developers connect to them directly from Shopify CLI via `shopify app dev`, and the AI Toolkit exposes CLI store management to AI coding tools, giving an agent-friendly path into the sandbox. GraphiQL adds a separate way to test queries. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and evidence that the agentic commerce MCP servers (cart, checkout, order) can be pointed at a sandbox or test mode.
